name: gsd-agentos
description: AgentOS-native adapter for the gsd-build/get-shit-done command surface.

commands.name: add-tests
commands.summary: Generate tests for a completed phase based on UAT criteria and implementation

commands.name: ai-integration-phase
commands.summary: Generate an AI-SPEC.md design contract for phases that involve building AI systems.

commands.name: audit-fix
commands.summary: Autonomous audit-to-fix pipeline — find issues, classify, fix, test, commit

commands.name: audit-milestone
commands.summary: Audit milestone completion against original intent before archiving

commands.name: audit-uat
commands.summary: Cross-phase audit of all outstanding UAT and verification items

commands.name: autonomous
commands.summary: Run all remaining phases autonomously — discuss→plan→execute per phase
commands.usage: ooo gsd autonomous [--from N] [--to N] [--only N] [--interactive]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [--from N] [--to N] [--only N] [--interactive]

commands.name: capture
commands.summary: Capture ideas, tasks, notes, and seeds to their destination

commands.name: cleanup
commands.summary: Archive accumulated phase directories from completed milestones

commands.name: code-review
commands.summary: Review source files changed during a phase for bugs, security issues, and code quality problems

commands.name: complete-milestone
commands.summary: Archive completed milestone and prepare for next version

commands.name: config
commands.summary: Configure GSD settings — workflow toggles, advanced knobs, integrations, and model profile

commands.name: debug
commands.summary: Systematic debugging with persistent state across context resets
commands.usage: ooo gsd debug [list | status <slug> | continue <slug> | --diagnose] [issue description]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [list | status <slug> | continue <slug> | --diagnose] [issue description]

commands.name: discuss-phase
commands.summary: Gather phase context through adaptive questioning before planning.

commands.name: docs-update
commands.summary: Generate or update project documentation verified against the codebase

commands.name: eval-review
commands.summary: Audit an executed AI phase's evaluation coverage and produce an EVAL-REVIEW.md remediation plan.

commands.name: execute-phase
commands.summary: Execute all plans in a phase with wave-based parallelization

commands.name: explore
commands.summary: Socratic ideation and idea routing — think through ideas before committing to plans

commands.name: extract-learnings
commands.summary: Extract decisions, lessons, patterns, and surprises from completed phase artifacts

commands.name: fast
commands.summary: Execute a trivial task inline — no subagents, no planning overhead

commands.name: forensics
commands.summary: Post-mortem investigation for failed GSD workflows — diagnoses what went wrong.

commands.name: graphify
commands.summary: Build, query, and inspect the project knowledge graph in .planning/graphs/

commands.name: health
commands.summary: Diagnose planning directory health and optionally repair issues

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Show available GSD commands and usage guide

commands.name: import
commands.summary: Ingest external plans with conflict detection against project decisions before writing anything.

commands.name: inbox
commands.summary: Triage and review open GitHub issues and PRs against project templates and contribution guidelines.

commands.name: ingest-docs
commands.summary: Bootstrap or merge a .planning/ setup from existing ADRs, PRDs, SPECs, and docs in a repo.

commands.name: manager
commands.summary: Interactive command center for managing multiple phases from one terminal

commands.name: map-codebase
commands.summary: Analyze codebase with parallel mapper agents to produce .planning/codebase/ documents

commands.name: milestone-summary
commands.summary: Generate a comprehensive project summary from milestone artifacts for team onboarding and review

commands.name: mvp-phase
commands.summary: Plan a phase as a vertical MVP slice — user story, SPIDR splitting, then plan-phase

commands.name: new-milestone
commands.summary: Start a new milestone cycle — update PROJECT.md and route to requirements
commands.usage: ooo gsd new-milestone [milestone name, e.g., 'v1.1 Notifications']

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [milestone name, e.g., 'v1.1 Notifications']

commands.name: new-project
commands.summary: Initialize a new project with deep context gathering and PROJECT.md

commands.name: gsd-context
commands.summary: codebase intelligence | map graphify docs learnings

commands.name: gsd-ideate
commands.summary: exploration capture | explore sketch spike spec capture

commands.name: gsd-manage
commands.summary: config workspace | workstreams thread update ship inbox

commands.name: gsd-project
commands.summary: project lifecycle | milestones audits summary

commands.name: gsd-quality
commands.summary: quality gates | code review debug audit security eval ui

commands.name: gsd-workflow
commands.summary: workflow | discuss plan execute verify phase progress

commands.name: pause-work
commands.summary: Create context handoff when pausing work mid-phase

commands.name: phase
commands.summary: CRUD for phases in ROADMAP.md — add, insert, remove, or edit phases

commands.name: plan-phase
commands.summary: Create detailed phase plan (PLAN.md) with verification loop

commands.name: plan-review-convergence
commands.summary: Cross-AI plan convergence loop — replan with review feedback until no HIGH concerns remain.

commands.name: pr-branch
commands.summary: Create a clean PR branch by filtering out .planning/ commits — ready for code review
commands.usage: ooo gsd pr-branch [target branch, default: main]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [target branch, default: main]

commands.name: profile-user
commands.summary: Generate developer behavioral profile and create Claude-discoverable artifacts

commands.name: progress
commands.summary: Check progress, advance workflow, or dispatch freeform intent — the unified GSD situational command

commands.name: quick
commands.summary: Execute a quick task with GSD guarantees (atomic commits, state tracking) but skip optional agents
commands.usage: ooo gsd quick [list | status <slug> | resume <slug> | --full] [--validate] [--discuss] [--research] [task description]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [list | status <slug> | resume <slug> | --full] [--validate] [--discuss] [--research] [task description]

commands.name: resume-work
commands.summary: Resume work from previous session with full context restoration

commands.name: review-backlog
commands.summary: Review and promote backlog items to active milestone

commands.name: review
commands.summary: Request cross-AI peer review of phase plans from external AI CLIs

commands.name: secure-phase
commands.summary: Retroactively verify threat mitigations for a completed phase

commands.name: settings
commands.summary: Configure GSD workflow toggles and model profile

commands.name: ship
commands.summary: Create PR, run review, and prepare for merge after verification passes
commands.usage: ooo gsd ship [phase number or milestone, e.g., '4' or 'v1.0']

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [phase number or milestone, e.g., '4' or 'v1.0']

commands.name: sketch
commands.summary: Sketch UI/design ideas with throwaway HTML mockups, or propose what to sketch next (frontier mode)
commands.usage: ooo gsd sketch [design idea to explore] [--quick] [--text] [--wrap-up] or [frontier]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [design idea to explore] [--quick] [--text] [--wrap-up] or [frontier]

commands.name: spec-phase
commands.summary: Clarify WHAT a phase delivers with ambiguity scoring; produces a SPEC.md before discuss-phase.

commands.name: spike
commands.summary: Spike an idea through experiential exploration, or propose what to spike next (frontier mode)
commands.usage: ooo gsd spike [idea to validate] [--quick] [--text] [--wrap-up] or [frontier]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [idea to validate] [--quick] [--text] [--wrap-up] or [frontier]

commands.name: stats
commands.summary: Display project statistics — phases, plans, requirements, git metrics, and timeline

commands.name: surface
commands.summary: Toggle which skills are surfaced — apply a profile, list, or disable a cluster without reinstall

commands.name: thread
commands.summary: Manage persistent context threads for cross-session work
commands.usage: ooo gsd thread [list [--open | --resolved] | close <slug> | status <slug> | name | description]

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: [list [--open | --resolved] | close <slug> | status <slug> | name | description]

commands.name: ui-phase
commands.summary: Generate UI design contract (UI-SPEC.md) for frontend phases

commands.name: ui-review
commands.summary: Retroactive 6-pillar visual audit of implemented frontend code

commands.name: ultraplan-phase
commands.summary: [BETA] Offload plan phase to Claude Code's ultraplan cloud; review in browser and import back.

commands.name: undo
commands.summary: Safe git revert. Roll back phase or plan commits using the phase manifest with dependency checks.
commands.usage: ooo gsd undo --last N | --phase NN | --plan NN-MM

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: GSD-compatible argument string: --last N | --phase NN | --plan NN-MM

commands.name: update
commands.summary: Update GSD to latest version with changelog display

commands.name: validate-phase
commands.summary: Retroactively audit and fill Nyquist validation gaps for a completed phase

commands.name: verify-work
commands.summary: Validate built features through conversational UAT

commands.name: workspace
commands.summary: Manage GSD workspaces — create, list, or remove isolated workspace environments

commands.name: workstreams
commands.summary: Manage parallel workstreams — list, create, switch, status, progress, complete, and resume

capabilities.name: seed
capabilities.reason: Project, plan, and import commands can project GSD planning artifacts into Ouroboros Seed context.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Every invocation records audit/provenance evidence under the target repository.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Write resumable GSD-to-AgentOS handoff state under .ouroboros/handoffs/gsd/.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Capture upstream GSD command source, version, argv, target repo, outputs, and status.

capabilities.name: runtime
capabilities.reason: Optionally run bounded upstream GSD command adapters when shell execution is explicitly trusted.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach planning, execution, verification, and review outputs as AgentOS-readable handoff bundles.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Preserve GSD progress/status semantics in durable AgentOS artifacts.

permissions.reason: Inspect upstream command catalog, target repository, and planning files.
Write handoff, state, provenance, and converted planning artifacts into the target repository.
Run bounded upstream GSD machinery or project verification commands only when explicitly trusted.
Some upstream GSD research/design commands may consult external documentation.
